rules.title: A suppression says why the finding cannot be fixed
rules.text: `# type: ignore` and `@SuppressWarnings` silence one finding at one line: the line says why the fix is not available here, so the next reader can tell a deliberate exception from a warning that was made to stop.

judgement.question: Is this suppression unexplained: does nothing on the line or the line above say why the finding cannot be fixed here?

criteria.true: nothing explains it: the lint is silenced and no words on this line or the line above say anything about why the finding cannot be fixed here
criteria.false: the line or the line above explains it, in words about why the finding cannot be fixed here
